title: ‘The Girls’: Khloé Kardashian Wanted Her Friends to Have Their Own Show. Then Things Got Complicated
summary: The reality TV veteran and businesswoman speaks about executive producing her inner circle, the moments when she "regretted doing any of this," what's next for 'Khloé in Wonder Land' and the October premiere of 'The Kardashians' season eight, exclusively confirmed to The Hollywood Reporter.
